detail: Continues the v3 action log (token-radar-entry-v3/action_log.jsonl). v3 dev grade 92.15% (90% CI 89.57%-94.72%), leaders ~93-94%. Read V3_SUMMARY.md, RULES.txt, and v3's lib/model.ts, main.ts, dashboard and docs as reference for the v4 build

Valuation experiments on the sealed snapshot: winsorised targets, LTS, ridge, shrunk category intercepts, two-slope shrinkage, empirical-Bayes category effects, TVL-per-chain, category-relative TVL — none improves both blind tests, so valuation stays TVL alone. Odds experiments: log-age, interactions, extra features, L2 tuning — none beats logistic CV AUC 0.677. Bootstrap: rank ranges degenerate (width 0, monotone model) and are not shipped; implied-value refit bands are meaningful

Current-status Weibull launch clock fitted by Adam on (age, token status): lambda 46.745y, shape 0.503, betas [-0.128, -0.076, -0.334, 0.186, 0.488]; same-five-fold CV AUC 0.670, log-loss 0.4713, Brier 0.1509 vs logistic 0.677/0.4659/0.1487; median 12m odds 4.79% across all 758, 4.9% across the board; 12m odds fall with age (corr -0.21 across the board)

Wrote lib/model.ts fresh as radar-5: fitValuation gains a 10-fold CV column (0.6966 vs baseline 0.7805, x1.12) and term tests judged on all three blind tests; fitClock (Weibull PH, current-status); bootstrapRefits (200 resamples, seed 20261114, slope 0.397-0.6517, intercept 2.0165-4.0147); per-row bootstrap implied p10/p90 bands and launch_odds_12m on every board row; vendor/makefun-board.ts copied from the kit and sha256-verified (9ca51b6e...)

Wrote main.ts, dashboard/index.html, app.css, app.js fresh: 12m odds column with sort, 10th self-check pill (12m odds recomputed 197/197), KPI strip gains 10-fold x1.12 and median 12m odds 4.9%, model panel gains clock section, bootstrap section and live farm matrix (FARM 14/8/0, THIN 39/79/26, SKIP 2/12/17), detail dialog gains 12m odds and refit band cells; wrote replay.sh, scripts/check-gate.mjs, LICENSE, .gitignore, .makefun/owner.json

Wrote STRATEGY.md, METHODOLOGY.md, README.md (badges + bounty link + referral 0y3dyvzz kept) for radar-5: clock coefficients and CV numbers, bootstrap intervals, term table with all three blind tests, farm matrix, near-miss Huber/L1 note, rank-ranges-degenerate note

Leaderboard re-checked 2026-11-23: top 5 unchanged; @owais-ahmad enters at #6 (comps-fitted), pushing @sudhan to #7, @behzad-khanlar to #8, @rstrike to #9, @brisk-kestrel-93 to #10, @nightshift-labs out to #11. #16 northpier radar-6 lists rank ranges + 2D farm matrix; #26 Sonar lists 12-month odds; #43/#44 bootstrap stability; #45 VERNIER no-token clock. v4 adopts the matrix, the clock and the bootstrap bands; rank ranges honestly rejected as degenerate

Re-took 1-board.png, 2-detail.png, 3-filtered.png at 1440x900 with headless Chromium via playwright-core (shot.cjs, file:// URLs, #p=sentora-curator for the detail shot, #watch=1 for the filtered shot); verified visually that the 12m odds column, the 10 self-check pills (including 12m odds recomputed 197/197), the refit band and 12m odds in the detail dialog render; widened the detail equation grid to 5 columns so all 10 cells fit in 2 rows and farm steps 1-6 are fully visible at 1440x900

Local gate mirror 7/7 pass on two consecutive replays; outputs byte-identical across both runs (board.json, data.js, dossier.json, screenshots); dossier 830,446 bytes; dashboard source 52,433 bytes (under the 65,536 cap); screenshots 172KB/237KB/173KB at 1440x900; no network strings in dashboard source; no superbot string in entry or output; data/index.json generated from the actual v4 outputs
